name.ja: 1/1000 アリゾナ級宇宙戦艦アリゾナ

description.ja: 『ヤマトよ永遠に REBEL3199』より、「アリゾナ級宇宙戦艦アリゾナ」が1/1000スケールで登場！ ■1/1000スケールで細部ディテール、モールドを再現したディスプレイモデル。
description.en: From "Yamato Forever REBEL3199 ", " Arizona class space battleship Arizona" is now available in 1/1000 scale! • A display model that reproduces fine details and molds in 1/1000 scale.

description.ja: ■船体形状を完全新規金型造形により再現。
description.en: • The hull shape is reproduced using a completely new mold.

description.ja: ■主砲はもちろん副砲も砲身の可動を再現。
description.en: • The movement of the barrels of both the main gun and the secondary gun is reproduced.

description.ja: ■エフェクトパーツ（陽電子衝撃波パーツ）が付属し、主砲の発射を再現。
description.en: • Effect parts (positron shock wave parts) are included to reproduce the firing of the main gun.

description.ja: ■角度調整可能なディスプレイベースが付属し、特徴的な飛行シーンを再現可能。
description.en: • Comes with an adjustable display base, allowing you to recreate unique flight scenes.

description.ja: ■台座用の船体銘ホイルシールが付属。
description.en: • A hull name foil seal for the pedestal is included.

description.ja: ■各種マーキングを収録した水転写式デカールが付属。
description.en: • Water transfer decals containing various markings are included.

accessories.ja: 主砲エフェクトパーツ(大、中、小)×各3
accessories.en: Main gun effect parts (large, medium, small) x 3 each
